results.title: Accra’s disturbing potholes endanger motorists
results.content: Some major roads and highways in Accra have developed serious potholes, making driving on those roads dangerous for motorists and other road users.

results.title: Prof Beyuo takes responsibility for medical bills of 12 injured in Hamile unrest
results.content: Lambussie MP Professor Titus Beyuo has offered to pay the hospital bills of 12 people injured in the violence that erupted in Hamile following a deadly explosion in the Upper West Region.

results.title: Education Ministry, Gates Foundation consider partnership to boost Ghana’s malaria research

results.title: Opoku-Agyemang calls for prosecution of perpetrators of sex-for-jobs abuse
results.content: Vice President Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang has called for prompt investigations into sexual exploitation allegations in workplaces and educational institutions, stressing that anyone found guilty must be appropriately sanctioned.

results.title: Assafuah rejects Mahama’s invitation to World Cup visa probe committee
results.content: Member of Parliament’s Youth and Sports Committee Ranking Member, Vincent Ekow Assafuah, has rejected an invitation to appear before a committee set up by President John Dramani Mahama to investigate alleged irregularities in the 2026 FIFA World Cup visa acquisition process.

results.title: Mahama sets monthly review of road crash data to measure TraffiTech results
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama says the government will use monthly road accident figures to determine whether the newly introduced TraffiTech system is reducing crashes and preventing deaths on Ghana’s roads.

results.title: Car dealers block Kwashieman footbridge walkway, exposing pedestrians to danger
results.content: Roadside car dealers have blocked the pedestrian walkway leading to the Kwashieman footbridge in Accra, making it difficult for pedestrians to cross the N1 highway.

results.content: The Ghana Union of Traders’ Associations (GUTA) has raised concerns over the rapid expansion of Chinese-owned shopping malls in the country, claiming that they are taking an estimated 60 per cent share of the market and putting pressure on local businesses. results.title: EU says galamsey is eroding gains from development projects in Ghana
results.content: The European Union has raised concerns that illegal mining is reversing development gains in Ghana, warning that the practice is threatening investments in agriculture, sanitation, security and environmental protection.

results.title: Mahama briefs diaspora Ghanaians on $1 billion housing mortgage scheme
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has urged the Ghanaians in the Caribbean to take advantage of a $1 billion mortgage initiative designed to help citizens at home and abroad to become homeowners.

results.title: Finance Minister applauds Nyakrom Community Bank for pioneering banking initiative
results.content: Dr Cassel Ato Forson, the Minister of Finance and Economic Planning, has applauded the Nyakrom Community Bank PLC for its pioneering initiative in Rural /Community banking.

results.title: Japan Motors CEO Salem Kalmoni unveils his 6 rules for business success
results.content: Business mogul Salem Kalmoni says the lessons he has gathered from years of managing a family-owned enterprise have taught him that success depends as much on avoiding costly mistakes as it does on pursuing growth.

results.title: Cenpower celebrates its journey and contribution to Ghana’s energy sector
results.content: Cenpower Generation Ltd (Cenpower), owner of the 350 MW Kpone Independent Power Plant (KIPP), has marked a significant milestone in its development journey by celebrating the decade since the power plant's sod-cutting ceremony.

results.title: GUTA urges authorities to act over Chinese malls’ impact on local businesses
results.content: The President of the Ghana Union of Traders’ Associations (GUTA), Clement Boateng, has urged authorities to examine the expansion of Chinese shopping malls, warning that local businesses are losing market share.

results.title: Obuasi abuse allegations: Coalition demands national child-protection overhaul
results.content: The National Coalition for Proper Human Sexual Rights and Family Values has called for a comprehensive overhaul of Ghana's child-protection system, warning that the allegations of sexual abuse at the Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) expose weaknesses that could leave children vulnerable in schools and other institutions.

results.title: Goods delayed, banks demanding repayment – GUTA President details traders’ pressures
results.content: Rising cargo volumes are causing port congestion and delaying goods clearance, the President of the Ghana Union of Traders’ Associations (GUTA), Clement Boateng, said.

results.title: Choose engineering over business degrees – Salem Kalmoni advises youth
results.content: Young Ghanaians have been encouraged to pursue engineering and other technical disciplines rather than follow the growing preference for business administration qualifications, which are increasingly common in the job market.

results.title: GUTA President calls for loan repayment moratorium as shipment delays hit traders
results.content: GUTA President Clement Boateng has called for a moratorium on loan repayments to give traders breathing space as shipment delays leave them facing bank demands before their goods arrive.

results.title: Telecel Ghana Foundation expands Homecoming to support over 500 patients nationwide
results.content: The Telecel Ghana Foundation has launched the 2026 edition of its annual flagship Homecoming initiative, aiming to discharge over 500 insolvent patients across 16 government health facilities nationwide.

results.title: Morocco’s King Mohammed VI orders coordination of MINURSO withdrawal, reaffirms ceasefire commitment
results.content: Morocco’s King Mohammed VI has directed the government to coordinate and support the withdrawal of the United Nations mission in Western Sahara, while reaffirming the kingdom’s commitment to the ceasefire.

results.title: Raise your children to carry the business torch — Salem Kalmoni advises Ghanaian entrepreneurs
results.content: Ghanaian entrepreneurs have been urged to introduce their children to their businesses from an early age to prepare them for leadership and improve the chances of enterprises surviving beyond their founders.

results.title: UAE shipments now take up to four months to arrive – GUTA President
results.content: Goods shipped from the United Arab Emirates now take up to four months to reach Ghana, leaving traders facing delayed deliveries and pressure to repay banks, GUTA President Clement Boateng said.

results.title: Some regions face higher inflation than national average – GNCCI CEO
results.content: Some regions are recording inflation above the national average, despite easing price pressures overall, the Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana National Chamber of Commerce and Industry said.

results.title: Lift Hamile curfew completely – Lambussie MP urges government
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Lambussie, Professor Titus K. Beyuo, has called on the government to end the curfew in Hamile, arguing that the security restrictions are now causing considerable hardship despite an apparent return to normal life in the border community.

results.title: ‘Things are a bit better’ – GNCCI CEO on business conditions
results.content: The CEO of the Ghana National Chamber of Commerce and Industry (GNCCI), Mark Badu-Aboagye, says production costs still need improvement.

results.title: Tax relief, falling interest rates ease business costs – GNCCI CEO
results.content: Tax relief and falling interest rates are easing production costs, but businesses still face pressure, the Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana National Chamber of Commerce and Industry (GNCCI) said.

results.title: All unauthorised billboards in Accra to be removed on November 14
results.content: State authorities and industry leaders have issued a final ultimatum to media agencies and property owners across the capital: clearly brand your outdoor advertising structures within seven days or see them dismantled in a massive joint enforcement sweep scheduled for November 14, 2026.

results.title: King Charles relishes ‘politically charged’ deployments, Palace aide says
results.content: The King Charles relishes the "tough parts" of his role and will continue to be used in "politically charged situations", a senior palace aide said at the end of the King's tour of the Caribbean.

results.title: Over 53, 000 teenagers pregnant in 7 months – Advocates raise alarm
results.content: A total of 53,415 adolescent girls in the country became pregnant in the first half of 2026, according to data released by the Ghana Health Service (GHS).

results.title: Salem Kalmoni outlines 8 key factors for his family’s business success in Ghana
results.content: Family cohesion, perseverance and a commitment to honest work have been central to the longevity of the Kalmoni business enterprise, according to the Chief Executive Officer of Japan Motors Ghana, Salem Kalmoni.
